leaves.doc: kleiman-site: Kleiman, *The Picard scheme* (arXiv math/0504020), Thm 9.5.4 with Def. 9.2.2 as printed: for `X` projective, geometrically integral and geometrically normal over a field `K` with a `K`-point, the identity component of any scheme locally of finite type over `K` representing the sheafification of `T ↦ Pic(X_T)/Pic(T)` on the site of locally Noetherian `K`-schemes with the fppf topology is proper (locator UNVERIFIED on host).
leaves.flag: locator UNVERIFIED: printed form of Kleiman 9.5.4 over Kleiman's own site (locally Noetherian K-schemes, fppf) and Def. 9.2.2's quotient functor; extra hypotheses (a K-point, geometric normality after every field) only weaken it; no copy of the text on the host
